in_marathi.name: किशन
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon, God of Rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: किशन हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Kishora’ or ‘Krishna’, meaning ‘Moon’ or ‘God of Rain’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is the eighth avatar of Vishnu, known for his divine love, wisdom, and power.

in_bengali.name: किशन
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon, God of Rain
in_bengali.long_meaning: किशन একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Kishora’ or ‘Krishna’, meaning ‘Moon’ or ‘God of Rain’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is the eighth avatar of Vishnu, known for his divine love, wisdom, and power.
